name: The Reliquary Run
hook: When the Sea first began to leave, the Mnemarchs hid their holiest Litany — the Choir-Crystal called Nine Mouths, which remembers the exact sound Veyl made when it learned its dead were dead — in the deepest brine-pit on the shelf, trusting the water to guard…
setup: Play on a roughly 4x4 board divided into a 4x4 grid of sixteen zones. Build the board entirely from double-sided terrain overlays (wet side up / dry side up) so every zone can flip on the Toll. At game start, the OUTER ring of twelve zones is Brine-deep (wet side up); the inner 2x2 of four zones — the Choir-Pit — is also Brine-deep. Place crystal models as physical objects: ONE Choir-Crystal (Nine Mouths, a large model, the Prize) Loose at the dead center of the Choir-Pit, and FIVE lesser Litany crystals Loose, one in each of five randomly chosen outer zones. All six crystals begin in Brine-deep zones, so all six begin protected (AUTO-PASS shatter). Set up the Tide Track at 6 tides. Place…
deployment: Four factions, four board edges, deployed in that turn order: Mnemarchs, Brine-Factors, Ash Iconoclasts, Sediment. The first three deploy along their own board edge, no model within one zone of any crystal. The Sediment do NOT deploy a force — instead the Sediment player places NOTHING at start and is given the Grief pool: they bring models onto the board only by Re-dreaming Reliquiae out of drying pits (see special rules). The Choir-Crystal at center is equidistant from all three edge factions by design — nobody can reach it before the tide does.
objectives: The prize is custody of intact history, not a body count. Crystals score ONLY for the faction that controls them in their winning custody state when the Toll strikes Dry. A shattered crystal scores for NO ONE — it never happened. Each faction scores its OWN custody state: Mnemarchs score Set crystals; Brine-Factors score crystals taken OFF the board into the Hold; Iconoclasts score crystals they personally Shattered; Sediment score crystals that are Loose in a Dry zone they occupy (Drowned). The Choir-Crystal (Nine Mouths) is worth triple any lesser Litany to whoever's victory state it ends in.
twist: THE PIT REMEMBERS WHAT IT DROWNED. The Choir-Crystal, Nine Mouths, sits in the last pit to dry — and it is not empty. When tide 6 flips the Choir-Pit to Dry and the Prize finally surfaces Exposed, the Grief pool DISCHARGES: the Sediment player immediately Re-dreams up to their full Grief total of…
